title: Protect CI Workflows
summary: A Claude Code hook that pauses for your approval before the agent edits GitHub Actions workflows, GitLab CI, Jenkinsfile or other pipeline files.
description: Pipeline files run with your secrets and deploy rights, so a small edit can have a large reach. This PreToolUse hook does not block them. It switches the permission prompt on for those files, even if you allowed edits in general.
It matches workflow and action files under .github, plus GitLab CI, Azure Pipelines, Bitbucket Pipelines, CircleCI and Jenkinsfile. You see the proposed change and approve or reject it.
useWhen: Allow auto-accepted edits but keep a gate on pipelines
Review any change to deploy or release steps
Guard secrets that workflows can read
Catch an agent that loosens a permissions block

hook.command: node -e "let d='';process.stdin.on('data',x=>d+=x).on('end',()=>{let j={};try{j=JSON.parse(d)}catch(e){return}const i=j.tool_input||{};const f=String(i.file_path||'').split(String.fromCharCode(92)).join('/');const n=f.split('/').pop();const hit=/^(.*[/])?[.]github[/]workflows[/][^/]+[.]ya?ml/.test(f)||/^(.*[/])?[.]github[/]actions[/]/.test(f)||['.gitlab-ci.yml','azure-pipelines.yml','Jenkinsfile','bitbucket-pipelines.yml'].includes(n)||/[.]circleci[/]config[.]yml/.test(f);if(hit){console.log(JSON.stringify({hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:'PreToolUse',permissionDecision:'ask',permissionDecisionReason:'This file controls CI and can touch secrets and deployments. Review the change before it is written.'}}))}})"

example.prompt: Speed up CI by caching node_modules in the build workflow.
example.result: Claude Code stops and shows the edit to .github/workflows/build.yml. You approve it, or reject it and ask for a change.

faq.question: Is the edit refused outright?
faq.answer: No. The hook asks for a decision, so you can still approve a good change and nothing is lost.

faq.question: Does it work when I run in accept-edits mode?
faq.answer: Yes. The ask decision overrides auto-accept for the matched files, while other files keep their normal mode.

access: Reads the target file path of each Edit and Write call
Asks you to confirm matching calls and changes no file itself
